name: pi-skills
description: Skills-first Pi package with permanent Semantic-SQL memory, bioinformatics and R skills, detachable tasks, system-R RLM, and goals.

scripts.test: npm run test:memory && npm run test:rlm
scripts.test:memory: rm -rf .memory-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .memory-test-build --declaration false && cp extensions/memory/*.sql .memory-test-build/memory/ && node --test .memory-test-build/memory/memory.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .memory-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:rlm: rm -rf .rlm-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .rlm-test-build --declaration false && node --test .rlm-test-build/rlm/rlm.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .rlm-test-build; exit $status
